name: Maharashtra Girls Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFWS)
des: Maharashtra mein girl students ke liye tuition fee waiver ke 2 alag schemes hain jo aksar ek saath confuse ki jaati hain. Pehli: Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFWS) — introduced in 2007 by Ministry of HRD, implemented by DTE Maharashtra. Yeh ek supernumerary seat quota scheme hai jisme har AICTE-approved technical institution mein 5% extra seats allocated hoti hain jo eligible students ko 100% tuition fee waiver ke saath milti hain. Dusri: Girls Tuition & Examination Fee Waiver — GR dated 8 July 2024 ke under specifically girl students ke liye launched ki gayi, jisme OBC/EBC/Open sab categories ki girl students ko professional courses mein 100% Tuition Fee + Examination Fee reimbursement milta hai MahaDBT portal ke through. Dono schemes ka combined objective hai — Maharashtra mein girl students ke technical/professional education mein participation badhana aur financial barriers hatana.
benefits: TFWS Scheme: 100% tuition fee waiver for the entire duration of the course (only tuition fee — other fees like development fee, exam fee, library fee, insurance must still be paid)
TFWS: 5% supernumerary seats per course in all AICTE-approved institutions (Government, Aided, and Unaided Private)
TFWS: Available for B.E./B.Tech, Pharmacy, MBA, MCA, Hotel Management, and other AICTE-approved UG/PG professional courses
Girls Fee Waiver (GR 8 July 2024): 100% Tuition Fee + Examination Fee reimbursement for girl students in professional courses
Girls Fee Waiver: 100% benefit for girl students in government/aided institutions in ALL professional courses
Girls Fee Waiver: Available to girl students of OBC, EBC, Open (General), EWS categories studying in professional courses through CAP
Girls Fee Waiver: Amount disbursed via DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account through MahaDBT portal
Both schemes are applicable to girl students of Maharashtra state candidature (Type A to E)
criteria: Applicant must be a girl student and a Maharashtra state candidate (Domicile of Maharashtra — Type A to E candidature)
For TFWS: Annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 from all sources
For TFWS: Must appear in MHT-CET (or relevant entrance exam) and obtain a non-zero score; TFWS seat must be selected as a choice during CAP option form filling
For TFWS: Applicable for 1st year of Engineering/Pharmacy/MBA/MCA/Hotel Management admitted through CAP round
For TFWS: TFWS seat is a supernumerary seat — it is filled only if minimum 30% of sanctioned intake is filled in the course through CAP
For TFWS: Once admitted under TFWS, branch change and institute change are NOT permitted
For Girls Fee Waiver (GR 8 Jul 2024): Must be a girl student belonging to OBC, EBC, or Open/General category
For Girls Fee Waiver: Admission must be through CAP round — Deemed University and management quota admissions are NOT eligible
For Girls Fee Waiver: Must pass every academic year to continue receiving benefits; fee not reimbursed in year of failure
Student must not be enrolled in a Deemed or Private University (for MahaDBT-based scheme)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (mandatory for DBT in MahaDBT scheme)
Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (family income ≤ ₹8 lakh — for TFWS and Girls Fee Waiver both)
CAP Allotment Letter (mandatory proof of CAP round admission)
Admission Receipt / Fee Receipt for current academic year
Bank Passbook (Aadhaar-seeded account for DBT — for MahaDBT Girls Fee Waiver scheme)
MHT-CET Scorecard (for TFWS seat selection during CAP)
Category Certificate (OBC/EBC/EWS as applicable — for Girls Fee Waiver via MahaDBT)
application_process: Step 1: Appear in MHT-CET (PCM/PCB group as applicable) and obtain non-zero score
Step 2: Register for CAP admission on the official CET Cell portal: https://fe2025.mahacet.org
Step 3: While filling the Option Form during CAP counselling, select TFWS seat codes as separate choices for your preferred colleges/courses
Step 4: TFWS seat allotment happens as part of CAP rounds — check allotment result on CET Cell portal
Step 5: Report to allotted institute with income certificate and other documents for document verification and admission confirmation
Step 6: Tuition fee waiver is automatically applied by the institution — no separate scholarship application needed
